gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-cantarell: Bellota Text arrives with open, confident letterforms and no pen-shading. Cantarell follows in a friendly sans whose arches match their stems, so the heading's boldness has somewhere gentle to land.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Chiron Hei HK reads modern and businesslike, its c flung wide open like a bracelet pulled apart. Bellota Text brings the texture and the swagger; the body just gets on with it.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-commissioner: Open, shading-free curves are what mark out Bellota Text, which makes the heading feel direct and a bit unusual. Commissioner then carries a longer stretch smoothly, with no clogged curves and every stroke drawn at one thickness.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-didact-gothic: Distinctive is the right word for Bellota Text, with its open c, e and s shapes and no calligraphic shading. And Didact Gothic, a modern sans, never snags on a closed-up bowl, so big short headings can show off while the text stays out of the way.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 reads with a tube-like thickness through every bend. Bellota Text earns its keep big and short up top, where its open, shading-free shapes get room to show off the commanding side of the pair.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-doto: Bellota Text is the commanding one, with open c, e and s shapes and no calligraphic shading to guide the eye. Doto, a plain sans, is the quiet half, leaving wide margins of space around each glyph and generous mouths on its rounds.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-el-messiri: El Messiri has a moderate thick-thin ratio and a wide slot between the c's two ends, so it moves smoothly. Bellota Text has no pinched joins or swelling bowls, and the two sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-electrolize: Pliers-jawed and modern, that open c gives Electrolize a technical bite. And Bellota Text, with straight-edged, constant strokes up top, keeps the whole thing feeling confident when a longer passage rolls on below.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-elms-sans: Elms Sans reads like a ballpoint's pressure-free line, with a gap you can see through in each s. Bellota Text sits beside it with more swagger, open and commanding, so the two feel like a loud voice and a steady one.
